issues: Your live ad's 'Book now' button goes to http://fb.me/ - a Facebook link shortener - not to aadithyasolarenergies.com, so the spend never reaches the site you are paying to advertise.

With no Meta Pixel, no GA4 and no Google Ads tag anywhere in the site's <head>, nothing on aadithyasolarenergies.com can record who clicked, so even a visitor who does arrive cannot be counted or retargeted.
The <head> still carries the theme's default meta description, 'Solar Energy WordPress Theme' - the text Google shows under your listing has never been written for your business.

The theme is unfinished: the header prints the placeholder phone (229) 555-0109, the email link is labelled 'example@email.com', the service and 'About' links point at the theme demo on themexriver.com, and the footer shows two different addresses.
No Meta Pixel installed — can't run retargeting or track ad conversions
No Google Ads / GTM tracking — can't measure ad performance
No Google Analytics — flying blind on website traffic
No WhatsApp link — losing mobile leads (WhatsApp converts 3x better for Indian home services)
No live chat — missing after-hours leads
No visible testimonials/social proof on homepage
No structured data (Schema.org) - missing rich results in Google
No Open Graph tags - links look bad when shared on social/WhatsApp

site_evidence.note: Landing-page source read live on 2026-11-10 through the W3C Nu HTML Checker (validator.w3.org/nu/?doc=<url>&showsource=yes), which returns the served HTML with script tags intact, plus a direct fetch of the same pages. Tags found: no Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM or Google Ads tag.

promise_gap: Ad: 'Rs.78,000 వరకు Solar Subsidy వివరాల కోసం మీ వివరాలు నమోదు చేయండి' - register your details for solar subsidy information up to Rs.78,000, under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, with rooftop installation, bill savings and bank-loan help listed as tick-box benefits.

The subsidy figure and the service list are real and are on the site - EPC Services, Solar Rooftop Solutions, Residential Solar Installations and Solar Street Light and Fencing, with 5KW / 20KW / 45KW system sizes. But the ad's 'Book now' button goes to fb.me, so the visitor is asked to register on a Facebook page instead of the page that lists those services.
Ad: 'Aadithya Solar Energies ను ఈరోజే సంప్రదించండి, Call: 94910 32828'.

That number is on the site (tel:+91-9491032828 in the footer) - but the header of the same page still prints the theme's placeholder (229) 555-0109 above it, so a visitor sees two different phone numbers before they reach the real one.
Ad: 'మీ ఇంటి మీదే మీ సొంత Power Plant' - your own power plant on your own roof.

The site does describe rooftop solar and a Google Maps embed of the Gandipet office is on /contact/. Nothing on the site answers the question the ad raises - there is no savings calculator, no subsidy table and no price, and the only CTA is a 'Discover More' link that leaves the site for the theme vendor's homepage.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
